scope: Linux userspace translation integration and exploratory identical memory-workload comparison; no Android or iPhone speedup claim
limitations: Native has the full NCE program payload and runs capacity/memory regressions before the exchange workload; translated process has the small runtime ELF fixture and runs dynamic-code/signal checks first. Working sets differ.
Native sample has one CLI and one GCD run; each translated preemption mode has three CLI and three GCD runs, in separate groups. No randomized interleaving.
Native mapping profiling and fault tracing disabled for comparison. Translated default sampling is 100 ms; disabled sampling separately checked with CLI/GCD.
Elapsed time includes pipe system calls, synchronization and per-page assertions; memory setup and initial COW excluded.
Only UC_CPU_ARM64_MAX with FP/ASIMD guest HWCAP=3, 16 KiB pages, one Linux CPU. Linux installed/desired window tracking remains.

instructions.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; current window bookkeeping retained; no Android/iPhone integration
instructions.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and Linux window bookkeeping included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.

configuration_correction.cause: TCG buffer size was set after UC_CTL_TLB_TYPE initialized the engine. The setter updated the configuration field without reallocating the cache.
configuration_correction.interpretation: Recorded requested sizes are not effective capacities. 16/64 MiB rows do not compare different capacities. Other timing observations retain their original workload scope.
